name: Tracy Guy
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: I am a registered counsellor with a strong background in mental health, trauma support, and complex care environments. I bring over 20 years of combined experience in nursing, end-of-life support, and psychosocial work, with a particular passion for supporting individuals who have lived through trauma, chronic and progressive illness. I have a special interest in complex trauma (CPTSD), grief and loss, burnout, chronic and progressive illness, and recovery from high-pressure caring roles. I also provide training in Trauma-Informed Care and Vicarious Trauma for NDIS providers and frontline teams.

name: Victoria Caplan
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Vicky at Comfort Counselling provides a safe, confidential and non-judgemental space providing support for people seeking specialised counselling focusing on Grief, Loss & Bereavement. Grief including special needs children, trauma, family estrangement, pet loss, immigration, unemployment and more.

name: Vinay Nair
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Vinay Nair is a skilled counsellor who has been in the field for more than 15 years. He holds a deep understanding of the challenges individuals face across all age groups and life stages. His passion for counselling stems from his own life experiences and a strong belief in the importance of providing a hopeful and enriching environment for clients.

name: Vincent Viggiano
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: Vincent is a highly experienced counsellor and has completed a Masters in Counselling at Victoria University. He has over 17 years experience in the field of mental health and supporting individuals facing various psychological challenges. Throughout his career, Vincent has demonstrated a commitment to helping individuals overcome anxiety, depression and a wide range of mental health presentations, empowering them to lead healthier and more fulfilling lives.
